sources.title: ArtHouse Jersey, Development Grant Guidance 2027
sources.said: ArtHouse Jersey Development Grants are for professional and emerging professional artists aged 18+ working in any artform and based in, are from, or are strongly connected to, Jersey. … Development Grants are intended to support the development of an artist's practice, rather than to fully fund the delivery of a project or commission. … The total funding available annually is £55,000. You can apply for up to £5,000, but the amount requested is not necessarily the amount that will be awarded. … Deadlines: 1 February, 1 June, 1 October … Apply at least three months before your project is due to start.

figures.finding: Not reached; whether UK agreements govern work in Jersey is a held blocker. The 2025 list counts 34 awards (rows counted from the PDF); applications aren't published, so no rate of yes. The CI Touring Fund is for musicians only (page read).
